I found and left these useful recipe/inspiration pages open:

- **Complete BOTW recipe/cooking guide:** [IGN — All Recipes and Cookbook](https://www.ign.com/wikis/the-legend-of-zelda-breath-of-the-wild/All_Recipes_and_Cookbook) — a broad, categorized in-game cookbook with ingredient lists (vegetarian, seafood, meat, sweets, etc.). Great for naming/display inspiration.
- **Easy tropical centerpiece:** [Belly Full’s Disney-copycat Dole Whip](https://bellyfull.net/dole-whip-recipe/) — blend **4 oz pineapple juice, about 3/4 cup vanilla ice cream, 2 cups frozen pineapple, optional 2 Tbsp sugar, lemon, and salt**. Serve right away, or freeze 30–40 minutes and pipe with a star tip for the classic swirl. It also provides a dairy-free option using coconut milk.
- **Rich backup frosting:** [Sally’s Baking — Favorite Chocolate Buttercream](https://sallysbakingaddiction.com/favorite-chocolate-buttercream/) — creamy and piping-friendly. It makes **2½ cups**, enough for **12–16 cupcakes**; Sally’s method is simply beat softened butter, confectioners’ sugar, cocoa, cream/milk, salt, and vanilla.

**X-Carve Zelda sign/frame idea:**  
The strongest how-to I found is Paw Paw’s WorkShop’s **“Using the Picture Frame App in Easel.”** It demonstrates setting custom inner/outer dimensions, automatically cutting the photo window and rear rabbet/recess, then finishing the frame. For a Zelda menu/sign, use that frame workflow but engrave your menu text/Triforce motif in the border before cutting. The guide’s workflow uses an **1/8-inch straight bit**, includes tabs to sand off afterward, and the finished recess holds the acrylic/glass, printed menu, and backing.

**Quick Apple help**
- **Mirror iPhone:** Put the iPhone and Mac/Apple TV/AirPlay 2 TV on the same Wi‑Fi. Open **Control Center → Screen Mirroring → choose the Mac or TV**. To stop: Control Center → Screen Mirroring → **Stop Mirroring**. On a Mac, enable **System Settings → General → AirDrop & Handoff → AirPlay Receiver** first if needed.
- **Make iPad’s floating keyboard normal size:** Place two fingers on the floating keyboard and **pinch outward**. Alternatively tap the keyboard’s **More** button and choose **Full**.
